newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MARK DOMINATES LOW HUNGARY FX FUTURES TRADE.
newsitem.headline: MARK DOMINATES LOW HUNGARY FX FUTURES TRADE.

text.p: A strengthening mark dominated low turnover on Hungary's forex futures markets on Monday.
All trade was for December with the mark accounting for almost 90 percent of all contracts.
Traders said the interest was a direct result of a sustained weekend rally of the mark against the dollar on international spot markets.
The December mark rose 0.10 to 150.00 forints while the December dollar fell 0.60 to 189.30.
The mark also rose for March while the dollar eased for all maturities except June, which was stable.
The spot forint floats against a central bank currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
The Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) saw low turnover of 1.55 billion forints while there were no trades at all on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE).
